items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I remember it was the Otto Lang method I used.

ctx.x: Coming back again to your lessons with Perkins, what kind of stuff did he go over with you? Did he give you formal lessons?

Well, I was studying the violin. I remember it was the Otto Lang method I used. In fact, most of his instrument that he taught to use Otto Lang's book. Like it was time on, it was one of the violin, it was Otto Lang method, yeah.
And he taught you to read music?
